subject: MSstatsPTM - Setup with Phosphopeptides in 2 Fractions and total input in one

messages.author: ca31c2295ae7ae58
messages.subject: MSstatsPTM - Setup with Phosphopeptides in 2 Fractions and total input in one
parts:
Dear MSstats-developers,

I performed an phosphoproteomic experiment with 4 treatments in 4 biological replicates each (=total 16 samples). From each sample I have the total sample (=proteome) and two phosphoenriched fractions (TiO2, FeNTA). The separate phospho fractions were actually generated by tandem-enrichment following Thermo's SMOAC-protocol, meaning that the flow trough of TiO2 was again run over a Fe-NTA-column. 
I now ran the samples trough Spectronaut in two separate searches, once only the total total 16 proteome samples, and once the 32 phosphosamples. In the later search I labeled the individual phosphofractions in Spectronaut with unique identifiers during the experimental setup (TiO2, FeNTA).  
My question now is, if this is a sensible setup for MSstats-PTM to handle? Because of the two phospho fractions, the current long Spectronaut report will have quite some rows matching to exactly the same phosphopeptide but coming from different fractions. I assume MSStats by default will use only the most intense feature for a peptide according to the summaryforMultipleRows parameter? Since the actual amount of t such a peptide is actually the sum of its intensity in both fractions I guess I should rather use the "sum"-option for this parameter?
Or is MSStats treating fractions in a special way?

Best and thanks for this awesome piece of software.

Robert

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: MSstatsPTM - Setup with Phosphopeptides in 2 Fractions and total input in one
parts:
Hi Robert,

I have not seen this specific use case before so I'm not positive but MSstatsPTM should be able to handle this. I think you would need to make sure that the package is treating these fractions as duplicate rows and not unique technical replicates. To do this you would just want the run name to be the same for each fraction. Otherwise setting the summaryforMultipleRows  parameter to sum is correct.

I am going to check with the maintainer of the base MSstats Spectronaut converter and see if we have any additional examples on handling fractions.

Devon

messages.subject: Re: MSstatsPTM - Setup with Phosphopeptides in 2 Fractions and total input in one
parts:
Dear Devon,

thanks for the quick replies. Well at the moment the TiO2 and FeNTA fractions have different run labels, since they were actually distinct LC-MS runs. But since I also defined a fraction column in my custom annotations, the SpectronauttoMSstatsPTMFormat-converter recognises those (see attached log file) and seems to account for them. 
INFO  [2023-05-17 11:10:15] ** Multiple fractionations exist: 2 fractionations per MS replicate.
They apparently are not merged at this stage but remain separated. So many features now exist in duplicates, once with the „Fraction“-column set to 1 and once to 2. dataSummarizationPTM then apparently merges fractions. I am just not sure how? Is the merging of fractions simply achieved by summation? 

Best

Robert
